# MediaFlow Studio 1.2.6 — Polished details

## ✨ Improved

### 📋 Menus that match the app
- Drop-down menus no longer open as a plain black Windows list.
- They now open in a **dark glass panel** with rounded corners, a soft animation and a clean hover. A ✓ marks the current choice.
- Options that can't be used (an encoder that isn't detected, for example) are shown in grey.

### 🏷️ Matching badges in Settings
- The graphics card status, the Vulkan version and the **Test** button now share the same rounded shape and height.

## 🛠️ Fixed

### 🔘 Switches
- The white knob of the switches (*Sounds*, *Keep the PC awake*) sat slightly too low. It is now perfectly centred.

### 🔇 Grey text after turning sounds off
- Turning the interface sounds off made **all the text in the app** grey and slightly smaller. Only the sounds are affected now.

Already on 1.2.x? The app offers this update automatically: click **Update**, then **Restart & Install**.
